author: claude-opus-5-5
visual_review: Before: the mouse was a round circle with a small crooked notch, so it read as a letter 'e' or a clock under wifi arcs. After: a proper upright mouse pill with the right button outlined (a centre line from the top turning right, as in the reference) and two click waves about its top-right shoulder.
omissions: The mouse is drawn smaller than the reference so both concentric waves fit on VRECT_L with certifiable 9-unit spacing.
